description: parse_bundle_schema_version correctly parses 'major.minor' format, rejects leading zeros, malformed input, and unparseable strings. If Ok, input matches ^(0|[1-9][0-9])\.(0|[1-9][0-9])$
validate_bundle returns empty vec iff all required fields are non-empty. Each missing required field produces exactly one MissingRequiredField error. Empty gate/test/artifact arrays are valid.
write_bundle does not panic for any serialisable bundle and any valid path. Returns Ok(()) or a descriptive Error (BundleSerializationFailed or EvidenceWriteFailed).
read_bundle does not panic when deserialising well-formed bundle data in any supported format. Gracefully ignores unknown fields (no deny_unknown_fields).
Round-trip identity: write_bundle + read_bundle yields structurally equal bundle for all three formats (Yaml, Json, Postcard). Tests arbitrary EvidenceBundle values.
Fail-closed validation: bundles with empty linked_bead_id, empty executor context fields produce non-empty error vecs from validate_bundle. Shrinks to minimal failing case.
Path determinism: bundle_path(bead_id, fmt) is deterministic, extension matches format, and path starts with .evidence/.
No undefined behavior in Postcard serialization/deserialization paths. Miri runs on xtask crate with bundle module. Postcard uses unsafe repr transmutes internally.
